root: ^Stuffed Toy: It appears to be a heavily worn stuffed animal.
^Dust shakes from the ceiling. Alarms wail above. A mother grips her daughter's hand, yanking her down the stairs.
^Mother: Just hold on! Don’t let go!
^The girl stumbles. A ripped stuffed bunny tumbles from her arms, landing on the stairs behind them.
^Daughter: No—Lili!! Mommy, I dropped my Lili!!
^Mother: Forget it! We have to go!
^The bunny lies still as their footsteps fade, sirens echoing like a distant scream.
